scope: 0.3.4.2 release replacement; development checks plus published portable checks
changes: Bind sidebar selection to its own native ScrollViewer compositor scroll, including separate footer ownership.
Clip sidebar marker to the native viewport so it cannot paint into occluded areas.
Use a fixed native viewport clip and a moving song-content clip for song list and playback queue.
Release all three scroll bindings when their surfaces unload or the window hides.

nativeInspection.method: Native screen capture during opt-in UI-thread pause while native animated scrolling continues. Diagnostic brushes are restored after checks; screenshots remain in ignored local artifacts.

limitations: Native animated/programmatic scrolling was checked; physical touch hardware was not tested.
RenderTargetBitmap can synchronize layout, so same-frame raster checks alone do not prove behavior under a blocked UI thread. Native screen inspection and compositor-binding checks supplement them.

The broader local-motion suite timed out waiting for the second card artwork at LocalMotionChecks.cs:73, before cover-region checks ran. Replacing only SelectionMotion.cs with the previous 5be7e47 revision reproduces the identical timeout; see baseline-local-motion.json and after/local-motion.json. This suite is not counted as passing.
Earlier sequential TransformToVisual samples were discarded because they can observe different compositor times and do not support a before/after numerical comparison.
